summary: Verified mobile white-screen fix (mobile.css :not(body):not(html)). Home '/' and '/inicio.html' render visibly on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080: body computed display=block, #site visibility=visible, both cards ('Concurso Público do Município de Curitiba - PR' and 'Processo Seletivo Simplificado (PSS)') present, banner image visible, no horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth=390). Front-end POST /api/track/access fired with 200 on both viewports. Backend regression: 11/11 pytest pass (GET /api/, admin login donas, KPIs 401 without token / 200 with token, track/access new/duplicate/admin-skip, KPI ACESSOS increments, CSP connect-src, tracker script, mobile.css fix served).

issues: Small empty icon placeholders visible inside the 'PR' UF chip, the header search input and the 'Área do Candidato' button (icons appear blank) - cosmetic, low priority
Mobile: second card's logo seal slightly overlaps bottom of the first card (card-selo margin) - cosmetic

critical_code_review_comments: mobile.css hide selector is still broad ([class*='vw-'] etc.) - would hide any non-body element whose class contains 'vw-' substring (e.g. 'preview-...'); consider scoping more tightly
test_track_access.py uses a localhost default for BASE_URL (should rely on env only)
seed_data_creation: Only access-tracking records with test_visitor_* ids created by pytest and browser visits
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root '/' returns the home content directly (also /inicio.html). Use page listeners (not expect_response) in Playwright - expect_response around goto hung the tool. Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported; pytest.ini uses xdist.
